commands:
nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'smtp,465,submission' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] courier-smtp: started on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail courier-smtp has been started successfully.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] courier-smtp: stopped on <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The jail courier-smtp has been stopped.\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

( printf %b "Subject: [Fail2Ban] courier-smtp: banned <ip> from <fq-hostname>
Date: `LC_ALL=C date +"%a, %d %h %Y %T %z"`
From: Fail2Ban <root@<fq-hostname>>
To: root@localhost\n
Hi,\n
The IP <ip> has just been banned by Fail2Ban after
<failures> attempts against courier-smtp.\n\n
Here is more information about <ip> :\n"
whois <ip> || echo "missing whois program";
printf %b "\nLines containing failures of <ip> (max 1000)\n";
logpath="/var/log/mail.log"; grep -m 1000 -wF "<ip>" $logpath | tail -n 1000;
printf %b "\n
Regards,\n
Fail2Ban" ) | /usr/sbin/sendmail -f "root@<fq-hostname>" "root@localhost"

Domain of sender address \S+ does not (?:exist|resolve)|550 5\.[71]\.1 (?P=email)\.\.\. (Rejected: .*|User unknown))$

^rejecting commands from (\S* )?\[(?:(?:IPv6:)?<IP6>|<IP4>)\] due to pre-greeting traffic after \d+ seconds$

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '80,443' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> DROP
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '80,443' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> DROP
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo '80,443' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> DROP
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo '80,443' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> DROP
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

files.jail.local:
[DEFAULT]
bantime = 2h
[sendmail-reject]
enabled = true
backend = auto
logpath = /dev/null tail
maxretry = 0
action = nftables-multiport[blocktype=DROP, port="80,443"]
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=more]
[courier-smtp]
enabled = true
backend = auto
bantime = 1y
action = %(action_mwl)s
filter = %(__name__)s[mode=ddos]
